home.description: Weekly newsletters written by your friends!

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.subtitle: For the person who runs the loop.
signIn.invalidEmail: That doesn't look like an email address.

checkEmail.body: There's a sign-in link on its way. It works once and expires in 15 minutes.
checkEmail.previewCaptured: This preview captures email instead of sending it,
checkEmail.previewLogged: Every preview email is kept as a copy.

expired.body: Sign-in links last 15 minutes. Ask for a fresh one and it'll work.

used.body: Each link signs you in once. Ask for a new one to get back in.

unknown.title: That link isn't valid
unknown.body: It may have been truncated by your email client. Ask for a new one.

you.title: Your loops
you.emptyTitle: A blank page, in a good way.
you.emptyBody: No loops yet. Start one, or wait for an invite
you.footer: Reading is open to everyone in a loop. Writing needs an invite.

newLoop.customPlaceholder: What did you learn this week?

errors.name: Give the loop a name.
errors.timezone: That timezone isn't one we recognise.

questionBank.text: What made you laugh this week?
What are you looking forward to?
What's something small you're proud of?
What did you eat that was worth remembering?
What's the last thing that surprised you?
Who did you talk to this week that you want to see again?
Who's someone you've been thinking about lately?
What's something you'd like to thank someone for?
Where did you go that was worth the trip?
What's a place you keep meaning to visit?
What did you change your mind about recently?
What's something you're bad at and enjoying anyway?
